background_story: Wes had always been fascinated by architecture and design. Growing up, he spent hours building intricate models of houses with his grandfather, a retired carpenter. After completing his degree in architecture, Wes worked for several years under a renowned architect, honing his skills and developing his unique style. Eventually, he decided to strike out on his own and start his own design firm. Wes's passion project was designing and building his dream house, a sustainable and modern masterpiece that blended seamlessly into its surroundings. The house, which he dubbed 'Serenity,' became a showcase for his talents and a testament to his dedication to innovative design. As his reputation grew, so did his portfolio, and Wes became known as the go-to architect for bespoke, eco-friendly homes.

If Wes founds a company, then he will manage a team.
If Wes gains recognition, then he builds unique homes and has attention to detail.
Anyone who becomes a successful architect or wins design awards will gain recognition.
If Wes leads a project, then he either manages a team or assists contractors (but not both).
If Wes either assists contractors or learns carpentry skills (but not both), then he contributes to design.
If Wes joins a construction project, then he either has building experience or learns carpentry skills (but not both).
For all humans, if they study architecture and have building experience, then they can become a successful architect.
